meta.title: Mnemion — One memory across your tools | Perseus XR
meta.description: Free, open-source memory for people, teams and AI agents. Connect your sources, keep control of access and bring your knowledge across platforms. Windows, macOS and Linux.

heading: Many agents.
One memory.
lead: Your knowledge, connected across people, apps and AI.
A shared memory that stays organised, traceable and under your control.
hero.note: Free forever. For individuals and organisations.

heading: Change tools.
Keep the context.
overview.body: Useful knowledge should survive the next conversation, the next device and the next app. Mnemion gives it a shared home.

features.title: Memory that stays yours.
features.body: Keep decisions, facts and useful context in a workspace you control. Run the service locally or on your own infrastructure. Your apps connect to the same memory.

features.title: Built to work together.
features.body: Give people and agents their own access. Separate private work, projects, clients and teams into spaces, with permissions checked whenever memory is used.

features.title: Bring your existing knowledge.
features.body: Connect folders, Git, Google Drive and Slack. Extend to other storage through rclone or your own adapter, with checkpoints and review for incoming changes.

features.title: See where answers come from.
features.body: Follow citations to source evidence and revision history. Inspect connections in Studio, or keep using ordinary Markdown and the graph in Obsidian.

features.title: Choose how it thinks.
features.body: Start with small, local embedding models or connect an approved model endpoint. Compare a new index before switching, with controls for resources and data leaving your system.

features.title: Understand how it performs.
features.body: Explore memory, ingestion and resource charts. Build your own evaluation sets, compare retrieval runs and inspect the evidence behind each result.

heading: Make yourself
at home.
downloads.body: A desktop home for your memory. Connect to your workspace from Windows, macOS or Linux, without installing a model on every computer.
downloads.background: Automatic stable updates are on by default. Background mode keeps your workspace close at hand.
downloads.browser: Prefer the browser? Studio is also included with your Mnemion service. Linux AppImage supports automatic updates; managed installations follow your organisation’s policy.
downloads.mac: On Mac, move Studio into Applications. Your first launch may need approval in Privacy & Security.
downloads.windows: Windows may show an unknown-publisher message on the first install.

platforms.macos: macOS 13+ · Local workspaces on Apple silicon need macOS 14+ · Disk image

guidance.mobile: Use Studio through your workspace’s browser address, or choose a download for your computer.
guidance.unsupported32Bit: Studio requires a 64-bit computer. You can choose a download for another computer below.
guidance.macProcessor: In Apple menu → About This Mac, “Chip” means Apple silicon; “Processor” identifies an Intel Mac.
guidance.processor: Choose your processor. If you’re unsure, check the system information on your computer.
guidance.ready: Free forever. Connect to your own workspace, with automatic updates included.
guidance.releaseUnavailableBody: Check the current published releases on GitHub for available downloads.
guidance.pendingDownload: This download is not currently available.
guidance.chooseDownload: Choose your computer and processor to download.
guidance.changeComputer: You can always choose a different computer.

steps.title: Open your workspace.
steps.body: Install Studio. Join a team with its workspace address and your personal sign-in or invitation; an administrator can also give an agent its own scoped key. Starting your own? Choose Create on this computer in the app, or connect to a service on your infrastructure.

links.label: Sign in or join a team

steps.title: Bring your knowledge.
steps.body: Create your spaces, connect the sources you choose and decide who can access them. Your personal notes and your team’s memory can stay separate.

steps.title: Give your agents continuity.
steps.body: Connect assistants through MCP or the API. Search, review and explore in Studio; use Obsidian when you want your familiar notes and graph.

heading: Know what’s here.
See what’s next.
resources.body: Read guides for the version you download and follow the latest roadmap. The same help is available inside the app, including offline.

resources.updateBody: Supported desktop installations check for stable updates automatically and restart when idle, with protection for work in progress. Workspace administrators manage service upgrades.

heading: Yours to use.
Always free.
free.body: Mnemion is free for individuals, teams and organisations. All features and updates are included. There are no paid tiers, subscriptions or charges per person.
free.supportBody: If Mnemion helps you, you can support its development from €5. Give more if you like. It is entirely optional.
free.contributeBody: Use it on your own infrastructure and contribute in the way that suits you: feedback, documentation, code or optional support.
free.providerNote: You control your infrastructure and model choices. Hosting, storage or model providers you select may have their own costs; Mnemion does not require a paid model or memory subscription.

project.clientLabel: Perseus XR · Free for individuals and teams
project.commercialProblem: Useful context gets scattered across apps, agents, sources and machines.
project.method: Shared memory spaces with scoped access, source-linked retrieval and Obsidian-compatible Markdown.
project.outcome: One organised memory system for people, teams and AI agents, with portable data and a free, open-source foundation.
